name: Add API Template
about: Request a new API to be added to our template library
title: '[TEMPLATE] Add <API Name>'

---

**API Name**
Name of the API you want to add (e.g., Stripe, GitHub)

**API Website**
URL to the API's homepage

**OpenAPI/Swagger Spec URL**
URL to the OpenAPI or Swagger specification for this API

**Why should we add this API?**
Brief explanation of why this API would be useful to include in our template library

**Category**
What category does this API belong to?
- [ ] Payments
- [ ] Development
- [ ] Communication
- [ ] AI/ML
- [ ] Email
- [ ] E-commerce
- [ ] Productivity
- [ ] Other (please specify)

**Additional Resources**
Links to documentation, changelogs, or version history that might help us track changes

**Would you be willing to help maintain this template?**
- [ ] Yes, I can submit a PR
- [ ] Yes, with guidance
- [ ] No
